name: Poha Idli
steps: Rinse poha quickly, drain and let it soften for 5 minutes. Pulse it into a coarse paste rather than a completely smooth liquid.
Dry-roast semolina for 2–3 minutes without browning. Mix it with poha, curd, measured water and salt into a thick batter; rest 15 minutes so both grains hydrate.
Set the steamer water to boil and oil the idli moulds. Stir the batter; add a small splash of water only if it is too stiff to spoon.
Just before steaming, fold in fruit salt gently and fill moulds three-quarters full. Steam for 12–15 minutes until a skewer comes out clean; do not open the lid in the first 10 minutes.
Rest the idlis for 2 minutes, unmould and serve three soft poha idlis per person with coconut chutney. Add fruit salt only when the steamer is ready.
tips: A little coarse poha texture makes these idlis softer than using only semolina.
passiveTime: Rest the poha-semolina batter for 15 minutes.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
